assessment: Article establishes a B/N/H ReaxFF development context, not direct R2 coverage.
Presence of B/N/H chemistry does not prove accurate edge-passivant parameters for R2.
Dedicated bridge and attachment validation remains required.
Gas-phase synthesis validation is not equivalent to equilibrium mechanics of the selected R2 BNNT.
No water compatibility can be inferred from a gas-phase ReaxFF training domain.
R2 annulus, seed and passivated edge environments require explicit validation.
ReaxFF charge equilibration must not be treated as an independently validated aqueous polarization model.
